evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “Unlicensed Tour Operator Charged For Causing Deaths Of Five-Month-Old Infant And 27-Year-Old Woman In New York Harbor Boat Capsizing,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: United States Attorney for the Southern District of New York, Jamie McDonald, Assistant Director in Charge of the Coast Guard Investigative Service (“CGIS”), Josh Packer, and Commissioner of the New York City Police Department (“NYPD”), Jessica S. Tisch, announced today that MANUEL HERNANDEZ has been charged with negligently causing the death of a five-month-old infant and a 27-year-old woman, after the vessel HERNANDEZ was piloting capsized in New York Harbor. This current source item can be tested against the underlying record and connected to the relevant evidence lane.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
